description: React component implementing a tree-based UI for configuring filter scope in a dashboard, including functions for handling tree state, filtering, and scope updates.

classes.name: ScopingTree
classes.description: React functional component for rendering and managing a filter scope tree in a dashboard.

methods.name: buildTreeLeafTitle
methods.description: Creates a tree leaf title with optional tooltip and icon.

methods.name: separateKeys
methods.description: Separates checked keys into layer and non-layer keys.

methods.name: extractParentChartIds
methods.description: Extracts parent chart IDs from layer keys using regex.

methods.name: updateScopeWithParentCharts
methods.description: Updates filter scope with parent chart information based on layout.

methods.name: createFormValues
methods.description: Creates form values object with updated scope and selected layers.

methods.name: handleCheck
methods.description: Handles checking/unchecking tree nodes, updating filter scope accordingly.
